flags.why: The windowsill sense is current everyday usage, whereas the pronoun is now chiefly encountered in traditional verse and older speech ([VDict](https://vdict.com/b%E1%BA%ADu%2C3%2C0%2C0.html)).
Bắn tỉa names the shooting activity, while tay bắn tỉa in the example names the sniper.

The example uses bắt chợt as though it were bất chợt ('suddenly'), whereas the verb means catching someone unexpectedly doing something concealed ([ZIM Dictionary](https://dictionary.zim.vn/viet-anh/bat-chot-tieng-anh-la-gi-1)).
flags.fix: Tôi bắt chợt nó đang ăn vụng trong bếp. = I caught him sneaking food in the kitchen.
